units.source_text: 现在先说，现实世界和地狱之间有一条通道，叫暗穴道，

en.t: First, there is a passage between the real world and hell called the Dark Cavern Road,

units.source_text: 那是常年天地昏暗，疾风刺骨。

en.t: there the sky and earth are dim all year round, and a fierce wind cuts to the bone.

units.source_text: 杜子春被寒风裹挟而行，像无根的落叶飘荡在空中，

en.t: Du Zichun was swept along by the cold wind, drifting through the air like a rootless fallen leaf,

units.source_text: 不多儿，就来到了一座富丽堂皇的大殿跟前，

en.t: and before long he arrived before a magnificent and splendid great hall,

units.source_text: 大殿正中悬挂的牌匾上写了“阎罗殿”三个大字。

en.t: and on the plaque hanging in the center of the hall were written the three large characters, "Hall of King Yama."
